sloka: यत्र तिष्ठति धर्मज्ञः तपसा स्वेन भावितः ।मेरु सावर्णिर् इति एष ख्यातो वै ब्रह्मणा समः ॥४-४२-४८॥
transliteration: yatra tiṣṭhati dharmajñaḥ tapasā svena bhāvitaḥ ।meru sāvarṇir iti eṣa khyāto vai brahmaṇā samaḥ ॥4-42-48॥

translations.english: 'The sage Merusavarna, knower of dharma, famous for his penance and comparable to Brahma lives there with him on Meru.
